artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan implementing decision (a): narrow lean-plan-compliance-check.sh's Goals-prose fallback harvest to a per-bullet leading-identifier-run, re-baseline the four existing test cases the narrowing legitimately changes, add the record's required regression coverage plus first coverage of the Challenge-preferred harvest, and correct the stale plan_goals_preamble.md fixture comment.

memory_candidates.content: When porting lean-challenge-snapshot.sh's leading-identifier-run Goals harvest into lean-plan-compliance-check.sh (or auditing either reader), the two scripts' IDENT patterns deliberately DIFFER and must not be unified: lean-challenge-snapshot.sh exports LEAN_IDENT_PATTERN="[^\W\d][\w']*" (single-component, non-dotted), while lean-plan-compliance-check.sh's IDENT_PCRE is dotted ('[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_']*(?:\.[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_']*)*') because its landed DECLARATION-KIND AND DOTTED-NAME WIDENING depends on harvesting namespaced names like Outer.Shapes.Frame.ofParts. Copying the Python's pattern along with its positional algorithm silently regresses that widening; cases C16/C17 of test-lean-plan-compliance-check.sh are the covering check.
